headline: Molten Core in 31:56, thirteen minutes under the usual night, with one boss death

mvp.headline: most damage on five of the ten bosses, and nearly double the next on Gehennas
why: First on Lucifron, Magmadar, Gehennas, Baron Geddon and Sulfuron, second on Golemagg and Ragnaros, third on Garr
51k on Gehennas in 25 seconds, where the next best did 28k
Also the most damage in Blackwing Lair on Firemaw, Ebonroc and Nefarian earlier the same night

also.text: 71 dispels, 5 Impending Dooms on Lucifron and 3 Ignite Manas on Geddon
73 dispels, the most in the raid, after swapping in for Molten Core
most damage on Garr and Ragnaros (73k), and interrupted a Flamewaker Priest's heal on Sulfuron

overview: 10 of 10 in 31:56, against a usual 44:51 and the guild's best of 29:44. One boss death, Osinir on Majordomo, and one on trash. Every boss went down on the first pull.
The curses were handled: 30 Lucifron's Curses (Elozia and Orbywan 8 each), 34 Gehennas' Curses (Cladá 8) and 17 Shazzrah's Curses removed, and 15 Impending Dooms dispelled on Lucifron.
World buffs were thinner than in Blackwing Lair: 36 with Rallying Cry at Lucifron, Songflower on 25 and down to 2 by Ragnaros, Warchief's Blessing on 8.
A few characters swapped between Blackwing Lair and Molten Core (Fluffycatto to Sneakycatto among them), so 42 names are listed with 40 at every boss.

wentWell.text: Lucifron in 0:28 (median 0:37). 30 curses and 15 Impending Dooms removed.
Ragnaros in 0:49 (median 1:08), no deaths. Macharius took 43 Elemental Fires and Birkler 31.
Baron Geddon in 0:32 (median 0:46). Inferno hit 1.4 times per raider against a usual 2.2.

notes.text: 0:28 (median 0:37), no deaths. Thormund dispelled 5 Impending Dooms, Holiphucheal 4.
Birkler was mind-controlled twice, Hjärterkung once.
Lava Breath did 49k, over half of all damage taken; a usual kill has none in the log. Künigünde (9) and Icyvains (8) took all 17 Lava Bomb fire hits.
0:25 (median 0:33). Gertggs 51k, almost twice the next. 34 curses removed.
Rain of Fire hit 31 raiders 34 times, half the usual rate.
0:31 (median 0:47), no deaths. The night's one trash death was Gowned, to a Firesworn's Eruption.
0:32 (median 0:46), no deaths. Ignite Mana dispelled 13 times, Gallahan 4.
Groomz was the Living Bomb once; it caught Norgewian.
None of his 3 Arcane Explosions were interrupted; they hit 20 raiders 54 times.
0:37 (median 0:50), no deaths. Terrora, Tochopolvo and Yulepunch each kicked a Dark Mending.
5 of the priests' 8 Dark Mendings went through and healed them for 81k, against 29k on a usual kill.
Osinir died at 0:31 to a Flamewaker Healer's melee, 87% to 0 over seven seconds, the night's only boss death.
Blast Wave did 42k, 17% of the damage taken against 6% on a usual kill, and the Aegis of Ragnaros healed Majordomo for 32k.
Lava Burst hit 37 raiders 117 times, a bit above the usual rate.
